morphology_constructions.history: n-final uncompounded numeral + maṭ before ḍaṭ
listed bases + thuk, with separate catur supplement
listed bases + tithuk and rule-specific ordinal admission

source_policy_decisions.decision: Require completion of a number; an object completing a nonnumerical collection does not receive the ordinal suffix.
Insert maṭ only after an uncompounded n-final numeral. Preserve viṃśa and ekādaśa as general-ḍaṭ controls.
Retain thaṭ and maṭ as Vedic alternatives on the stated inputs without transferring thaṭ to ordinary prose.
Keep caturtha, turīya and turya as three accepted histories; do not infer one from another by surface similarity.
Admit katipaya, pūga, gaṇa and saṃgha only under their explicit ordinal rules, not as generally productive numerals.

open_or_blocked: Complete gender/case paradigms, wider Vedic accent and historical variant priority remain Open.
Unlisted collective nouns do not inherit tithuk by analogy.
The following ordinal rules from 5.2.53 onward remain unconstructed.
